text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the drive, Gramps. Go ahead and 
get some rest in the detached wing.

With the International Umamusume Racing 
Summit just two weeks away, I visited a 
villa owned by Tokai Teio's family 
alongside her.
As for why I came here—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As the host of the summit, I really feel 
this~ Everyone is coming from all over the 
world, so we've got to give them 
unforgettable hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I hereby grant you the privilege of 
testing out my hospitality plan~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, just relax and treat this place 
like the "Yukoma Inn"! Feel free to give 
me your frank opinion, alright?
choice_data_list:
Yeah! ...By the way, what's with that 
outfit?

Yeah! ...By the way, what's with that 
outfit?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This? It's formal wear! I want my guest to 
enjoy a truly gorgeous mood!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“—Here you are, esteemed guest. This is 
our 'Colors of Early Summer Full Course,' 
made using locally-sourced Yukoma 
ingredients.”
choice_data_list:
Delicious! ...But isn't this a little too 
extravagant?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yes. All the ingredients, including the 
wild sweetfish and round eggplants, are 
high-grade and fresh from the morning 
market. Please enjoy some Royal Hachimi 
after your meal.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Once you change into your swimsuit, enjoy 
an exquisite moment in a rose bath with 
finest roses floating in Yukoma's waters. 
If you'd like, allow me to fan you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides roses, we also offer milk baths 
and rice bran baths. We prepare them on a 
rotating daily basis according to our 
guests' requests.
choice_data_list:
(Mmm, the bath feels nice, but considering 
the hassle...)

text_block_list.text:
And so, after being treated to all sorts 
of hospitality by Tokai Teio...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how was that? This is definitely 
gonna work, right!

True, the hospitality is lavish and 
thoroughly satisfying. However, it must 
cost the inn extra and require far more 
effort than their regular operations.
choice_data_list:
Hmm, actually pulling it off might be 
tough...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk! I've already thought that 
through, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I run to buy the groceries myself, we 
save on delivery fees, right? And since 
daily specialty baths take extra hands, 
I'll do the regular chores like cleaning 
all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've already budgeted the costs and staff 
for the rest of our hospitality! As long 
as I cover it, we'll be totally fine!
choice_data_list:
But that would put too much of a burden on 
you.

But wouldn't that put too much of a burden 
on you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine with this much, fine! 
After all, I'm a genius, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Prez has high hopes for me. 
Doing at least this much should be a 
given!
choice_data_list:
Still, as things stand right now, I can't 
agree to that.

Still, as things stand right now, I can't 
agree to that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wh-Why, though?! I thought so hard 
about this! What's wrong with it, huh?!
choice_data_list:
With this plan, it might be pushing things 
a bit too far.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Impossible...? How do you know it's 
impossible? I'm telling you, I can 
definitely do it!
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant by impossible—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Fine then, see if I care! You 
stubborn dummy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Gnnngh~~, this is so frustrating~~. Why 
do you just assume I 'can't' do it?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh... so cold. I couldn't even bring 
a jacket. Geez..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it... was it like this 
back then, too? Before we signed the 
contract, I was running in the park and 
got scolded—)
"You can't push yourself any further!"
"You can't push yourself any harder!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Shut up! Who made you the boss?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Get out of my way!! You're not even my 
Trainer or anything yet!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(I almost burst into tears, but that was 
just because they were worried about me, 
right?)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Back then... Trainer scolded me for 
pushing myself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...No. I understand now too. When you say 
'impossible,' Trainer, you don't mean 
'can't be done'—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You were... worried about me, weren't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because I'd be sad if you collapsed.
Yeah, because I'd be sad if you collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! When Trainer stops me, there's 
always a good reason for it. I should've 
known that...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, would it be alright if I asked you 
once more?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I really want our hospitality to be 
top-notch. And I want to achieve that 
without me or anyone else having to push 
themselves past their limits.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, won't you brainstorm with me? The very 
best hospitality that'll bring joy to 
everyone involved.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yeah. Thank you, Trainer!
